hero.headline: Our Story
hero.subheadline: From a humble 10x10 tent at Cherry Creek Farmers Market to Denver's award-winning catering company — this is The Crock Spot story.

founders.headline: Meet the Founders
founders.description: In May 2010, Steven and Mandy set up a humble 10x10 tent at the Cherry Creek Farmers Market with one mission: deliver gourmet, fast-casual meals that are 100% customizable to every guest's taste.
founders.story: What started as a weekend passion project quickly grew into something bigger. By 2011, they had their first food truck. By 2017, they welcomed co-partner Peter and expanded to a multi-truck operation serving events across Colorado.
founders.quote: Our guiding principle has remained the same since day one: make people happy with amazing food — and have a blast doing it!
